---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new endpoint or a change to an existing one
title: "[request] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: []
---

## What you want

One sentence. (Example: "A `transliterate` endpoint that preserves diacritics
instead of stripping them.")

## Why

What pipeline would pay for this? Be honest — is this for your own agent, or
have you seen demand elsewhere? We'll ask follow-ups.

## Suggested shape

If you have one, the JSON Schema for the input and the JSON shape of the
output. If you don't, leave this blank.

## Pricing

What's the maximum you'd pay per call, in USDC? Is this a single-call primitive
or a batch-tier endpoint?

## Alternatives

What did you try instead? Why is the existing surface insufficient?
